logic.ratio: x_j=ln(completed_close_BTC[j]/completed_close_ETH[j]). At signal j use sample mean/std of the prior L completed x values x[j-L:j]; exclude current x_j. z=(x_j-mean)/sample_std; if std==0 use 0.
logic.entry: When in cash, z>entry_zscore_threshold targets ETH (BTC relatively rich); z<-entry_zscore_threshold targets BTC (ETH relatively rich); else remain in cash. Boundaries are strict.
logic.exit_and_switch: While holding ETH, hold if z>0.5; exit to cash when z<=0.5; directly switch to BTC if z<-entry threshold. While holding BTC, hold if z<-0.5; exit when z>=-0.5; directly switch to ETH if z>entry threshold. Extreme opposite entry has priority. Trade only on target changes.
logic.timing: Use only completed UTC daily closes. Execute at next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open; a switch sells then buys at that same timestamp and charges both legs.
logic.sizing: Independent $2,000 long-only spot account, at most one coin held at a time or cash. No shorting, leverage, yield, transfer, or pre-OOS holding.
